test_CompressedTransformer_layer_norm: test the CompressedTransformer class with layer_norm enabled and disabled to verify zero output for uniform inputs
test_CompressedTransformer_causal_attent: test the CompressedTransformer class with causal and non-causal attention to verify masked token behavior
test_CompressedTransformer_activation_fu: test the CompressedTransformer class with a zero activation function to verify equivalence to zeroed MLP weights
test_CompressedTransformer_embedding_siz: test the CompressedTransformer class with custom embedding_size and unembed_at_every_layer to verify residual and layer output shapes
test_CompressedTransformer_identity_embe: test the CompressedTransformer class with identity embedding to verify equivalence to the standard Transformer model
